turns.content: How do I get wifi on my computer, visuals please

Your computer is already connected and working great! But now you know exactly how to connect to wireless internet (also called a Wi-Fi) whenever you need to. The most important thing to remember is that wireless internet (also called a Wi-Fi) password — it's usually on a sticker on your internet box. Or internet box (also called a router). Keep that handy! The wireless internet (also called a Wi-Fi) small picture on your screen (also called a icon) in the bottom-right corner is your friend for checking your connection anytime.
